relationships.subject: AAV8-Di-C5
relationships.evidence_quote: Biochemical experiments with biotinylated peptides confirmed their self-assembly and PICK1 binding (GCN4-HWLKV, Ki,App = 119 nM; GCN4(7P14P)-HWLKV, Ki,App = 548 nM)

relationships.subject: AAV8-Di-C5
relationships.evidence_quote: Both AAV8-Di-C5 and AAV8-Di(7P14P)-C5 prevented allodynia, unlike the control, AAV8-tdTomato (Figure 1C).

relationships.subject: AAV8-Di-C5
relationships.evidence_quote: We concluded that the recombinant peptides could both prevent and reverse mechanical allodynia in both acute and chronic stages of neuropathic pain, maintaining efficacy for at least 1 year.

key_findings: AAV-encoded dimeric PICK1-binding peptides prevent CFA and SNI mechanical allodynia and reverse neuropathic pain for up to 1 year in mice.
DRG neuron transduction by intrathecal AAV8 is sufficient for pain relief; PICK1 target engagement confirmed with selectivity over PSD-95.
